name: Kohat Tunnel
connectingPointsDisplay: Kohat District — Dara Adam Khel Tehsil
facts: Kohat Tunnel, a 1.9‑kilometre marvel, opened in June 2003, cutting 20 minutes off the Indus Highway and letting long‑bodied trucks bypass the hairpin‑laden Kohat Pass.
Constructed with Japan’s Economic Cooperation Fund, the tunnel cost Rs. 662.6 million (US$2.4 million) and features a 7.3‑metre black‑topped carriageway with 3‑metre shoulders.
In January 2008, militants seized the tunnel, but Pakistani forces reclaimed it after fierce artillery, helicopter gunship, and machine‑gun fire, killing 24 insurgents.
